# MedPoint Partners

> Healthcare recruiting and staffing firm in Atlanta, GA, powered by NorthPoint. MedPoint Partners helps hospitals, physician practices, and healthcare organizations hire clinical and non-clinical people — as temp, temp-to-perm, or direct hire, plus retained search and RPO — and payrolls temps as Employer of Record.

## Contact
- Phone: 404-250-0790 or 678-777-5627
- Email: gus@stafffinancial.com
- Location: Atlanta, GA. Serves the Southeast; remote roles such as coding and billing are filled nationwide.
- Request talent: https://www.medpointpartners.com/request-talent.html
- Job board: https://host.pcrecruiter.net/pcrbin/jobboard.aspx?uid=Staff%20Financial.npsg

## Roles placed
- Nursing: registered nurses (RN), LPNs, CNAs, charge nurses and nurse managers, directors of nursing, chief nursing officers
- Physicians and advanced practice: physicians (MD/DO), medical directors, nurse practitioners (NP), physician assistants (PA-C), CRNAs, hospitalists and specialists
- Allied health and therapy: radiologic, CT and MRI technologists, sonographers, surgical technologists, medical lab and phlebotomy, respiratory therapists, physical, occupational and speech therapists
- Medical office and patient access: medical assistants, front desk and receptionists, schedulers and patient access, referral coordinators, precertification and prior authorization, credentialing and payer enrollment
- Revenue cycle, coding and finance: CFOs and controllers, revenue cycle directors, medical coders (CPC, CCS), CDI specialists, billing, A/R and collections, reimbursement and cost report analysts
- Healthcare leadership: CEOs, COOs and hospital administrators, practice administrators, practice and clinic managers, directors of operations, quality and compliance, healthcare HR

## Care settings served
Hospitals and health systems; physician groups and specialty practices; orthopedic and spine practices; ambulatory surgery centers; urgent care and primary care; home health and hospice; behavioral health; senior living and post-acute; labs, imaging and diagnostics; physical therapy and rehab clinics; PE-backed platforms and MSOs; community health centers and FQHCs.

## How it works
- Blinded shortlist of pre-screened candidates in 48 to 72 hours.
- Licenses and certifications checked before a candidate is sent.
- Custom screening questionnaire for every search; each résumé arrives with the candidate's answers.
- Optional candidate video introductions.
- Direct hire is contingency (fee on placement) with a replacement guarantee. Retained search is paid in installments with a full replacement guarantee. Temps are billed hourly with MedPoint as Employer of Record (weekly payroll, taxes, workers' comp, W-2). Temp-to-perm converts with a conversion fee agreed upfront.
- 105+ years of combined recruiting experience; 1,000+ candidate video introductions filmed.
